items.title: Marine Weather Statement issued June 2 at 7:25AM CDT by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.summary:
A Marine Weather Statement has been issued for the following areas...
Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM...
Galveston Bay...

At 715 AM CDT, the public reported a waterspout 20 miles northeast
of Crystal Beach. Scattered thunderstorms will impact Galveston Bay
and the nearshore waters from Galveston to High Island out 20
nautical miles through the morning. Isolated short-lived waterspouts
will be possible.
items.area: Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM

items.title: Flood Advisory issued June 2 at 7:25AM CDT until June 2 at 10:30AM CDT by NWS Tulsa OK
items.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of northeast Oklahoma, including the following
counties, Osage and Washington OK.

* WHEN...Until 1030 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 725 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2.5 inches of
rain have fallen.
items.area: Osage, OK; Washington, OK
